purpose: Isolate initial-state and vector-field differences against the pinned compiled ordinary-SEOBNRv4 dynamics before changing the native generator.
frequency_selection: Nearest low-sampling dynamics point using the centered numerical derivative of orbital phase.
derivative: Five-point centered derivative on the uniform low-sampling dynamics grid; compare native vector field at the identical recorded state.
continuation: Start DOP853 from the compiled reference state at the 0.04 frequency target and compare to the same low-sampling reference trajectory through the 0.05 target; rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-13, first_step=0.125 M.
interpretation: Diagnostic only. Sampled reference derivatives have truncation/interpolation error; their agreement does not prove Hamiltonian or flux parity. A continuation uses the reference initial state, so it does not validate native initial conditions or the finished waveform. Do not promote or train the ROM from this result.
